---
title: "Outlier Analysis"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
source("../R/01_data_loading.R")
source("../R/07_diagnostics.R")
```

# Load data

```{r}
# Load original data
data <- load_clean_data("../data/raw/StudentPerformanceFactors.csv")
```

# Find outliers

```{r}
# Fit model on all data
model <- lm(Exam_Score ~ ., data = data)

# Get residuals
resid <- residuals(model)
std_resid <- resid / sd(resid)

# Find outliers (residual > 3 SD)
outliers <- which(abs(std_resid) > 3)

print(paste("Found", length(outliers), "outliers"))
print(paste("That's", round(100*length(outliers)/nrow(data), 2), "% of data"))
```

# Remove outliers

```{r}
# Remove them
data_clean <- data[-outliers, ]

print(paste("Original:", nrow(data), "rows"))
print(paste("Clean:", nrow(data_clean), "rows"))
```

# Split into train and test

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(data_clean$Exam_Score, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)

train_clean <- data_clean[train_index, ]
test_clean <- data_clean[-train_index, ]

# Save
save(train_clean, file = "../data/processed/train_data_clean.rda")
save(test_clean, file = "../data/processed/test_data_clean.rda")
```

# Train stepwise model

```{r}
stepwise_clean <- train(
  Exam_Score ~ .,
  data = train_clean,
  method = "lmStepAIC",
  direction = "backward",
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10),
  trace = FALSE
)

print(paste("CV-RMSE:", round(min(stepwise_clean$results$RMSE), 3)))
```

# Train LASSO

```{r}
x_train <- model.matrix(Exam_Score ~ ., train_clean)[, -1]
y_train <- train_clean$Exam_Score

lasso_clean <- train(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  method = "glmnet",
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 1, lambda = seq(0.001, 1, length = 50)),
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)
)

print(paste("CV-RMSE:", round(min(lasso_clean$results$RMSE), 3)))
```

# Train Ridge

```{r}
ridge_clean <- train(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  method = "glmnet",
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = 0, lambda = seq(0.001, 1, length = 50)),
  trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)
)

print(paste("CV-RMSE:", round(min(ridge_clean$results$RMSE), 3)))
```

# Compare models

```{r}
results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Stepwise", "LASSO", "Ridge"),
  RMSE = c(
    min(stepwise_clean$results$RMSE),
    min(lasso_clean$results$RMSE),
    min(ridge_clean$results$RMSE)
  )
)

results <- results %>% arrange(RMSE)
print(results)

# Save best model (stepwise won)
saveRDS(stepwise_clean, "../models/final_model_clean.rds")
```

# Test on clean test data

```{r}
eval_clean <- evaluate_model(stepwise_clean, test_clean)
```

# Plots

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
plot_diagnostics(eval_clean)
```

# Compare with original

```{r}
# Load original
load("../data/processed/test_data.rda")
model_original <- readRDS("../models/final_model.rds")

# Predict
pred_original <- predict(model_original, test_data)
resid_original <- test_data$Exam_Score - pred_original

# Metrics
rmse_original <- sqrt(mean(resid_original^2))
r2_original <- cor(test_data$Exam_Score, pred_original)^2

print("ORIGINAL:")
print(paste("RMSE:", round(rmse_original, 3)))
print(paste("R²:", round(r2_original, 3)))

print("CLEANED:")
print(paste("RMSE:", round(eval_clean$rmse, 3)))
print(paste("R²:", round(eval_clean$r2, 3)))
```
